title: A GUN TAKES ITS ROUNDS WITH IT
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. A gun put into the backpack keeps the rounds it had, and those rounds came back with the next gun of that model taken from the backpack. When the gun left the backpack another way (sold at the stall, given to the hire or a teammate, or taken by a teammate from a pile) its rounds stayed behind, so the next SMG you equipped could come up with an empty magazine, or a free full one. Now those rounds leave with the gun, and the next one comes up on half a magazine as any found gun does. A gun lying in your own pile still keeps its load.
now: A gun that leaves your backpack takes its stowed rounds with it, so the next one of that model comes up on half a magazine.
